title.english: The Last Shift Is Still Work

pairs.target: zuìhòu yìbān zuò wán qián , tǎ wéi hái dé bān yìzhī kōngxiāng .
pairs.english: Before his last shift ended, Tavi still had an empty crate to move.
pairs.hanzi: 最后一班做完前，塔维还得搬一只空箱。

pairs.target: tā kǎ zài fēn huòjià xià , bú àiyǎn , què gānghǎo dǎngzhù chéng lù qǔ bǎn shí yào tuì de nà yíbù .
pairs.english: Stuck below the sorting rack, unobtrusive, it blocked precisely the step Cheng Lu took back to collect the board.
pairs.hanzi: 它卡在分货架下，不碍眼，却刚好挡住成路取板时要退的那一步。

pairs.target: qīngnián jiào tā bāng zhe tái yìtóu , tǎ wéi táiqǐ cái fāxiàn dǐxià jiá le gēn jiù zhā shéng , jiěkāi yǐhòu , liǎng rén fǎnér dōu xiǎnxiē duō shǐ le yìfēn lì .
pairs.english: The young man asked Tavi to lift one end. An old binding cord caught underneath; after releasing it, both nearly used too much force.
pairs.hanzi: 青年叫他帮着抬一头，塔维抬起才发现底下夹了根旧扎绳，解开以后，两人反而都险些多使了一分力。

pairs.target: shíliù zhōu de zuìhòu yìtiān bìng méiyǒu yīncǐ tíngxiàlái .
pairs.english: The final day of sixteen weeks didn't stop for that.
pairs.hanzi: 十六周的最后一天并没有因此停下来。

pairs.target: jì huái cuī hòumiàn nàliàngchē , wēn xiù zài lìngyìtóu hé xiāngdǐ , dù chéng tóng rén shuō shèngxià de huò bùnéng yīn xuéshēng míngrì zǒu biàn quánsāi dào jīnrì .
pairs.english: Ji Huai urged the next cart on, Wenxiu checked bases at the far end, and Du Cheng told someone not to squeeze tomorrow's cargo into today because a student was leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 纪槐催后面那辆车，温岫在另一头核箱底，杜澄同人说剩下的货不能因学生明日走便全塞到今日。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng kōngxiāng fàngdào cèbiān , chéng lù xiānhuíqù xiě shù , méi rén jiào tā zhàn zhe děng yíjù xiàng sòngbié dehuà .
pairs.english: Tavi moved the empty crate aside; Cheng Lu resumed recording, nobody making him stand for a farewell speech.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将空箱放到侧边，成路先回去写数，没人叫他站着等一句像送别的话。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , ruǎn héng lái zhǎo tā hé zuìhòu jǐxiàng .
pairs.english: That afternoon Ruan Heng checked the final items with him.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，阮衡来找他核最后几项。

pairs.target: bàogào tānkāi , běilù nà zhāng cuò jiàntóu zài qián , gǎiguò de tú zài hòu , wēn xiù zhuāngpèi de shǒu lù lìng jiá yíchù ; liǎngtóu tuōjià zhī xiě yǐ hé xiāngdǐ yǔ xiàndìng qīngzǎi , bù ná tāmen tì suǒyǒu dōng huò zuò dānbǎo .
pairs.english: In the open report the north-road wrong arrow preceded the corrected drawing, Wenxiu's assembly hand route separate; both cradles covered only verified bases and specified light loads, not a guarantee for all winter freight.
pairs.hanzi: 报告摊开，北路那张错箭头在前，改过的图在后，温岫装配的手路另夹一处；两头托架只写已核箱底与限定轻载，不拿它们替所有冬货作担保。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fān dào zìjǐ nà jǐyè zhǔnbèi yǔ dúshù , hūrán juéde zuì xiǎng cáng de jǐchù , yě quèshí shì zìjǐ zuò guò de huó .
pairs.english: Turning to his own preparation and readings, Tavi felt the pages he wanted to hide most were indeed work he'd done.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维翻到自己那几页准备与读数，忽然觉得最想藏的几处，也确实是自己做过的活。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng kàn wán , shuō tā huì xiān kàn rén zěnme zuò , kěn wèn , yě huì yīn pà xiǎnde bù dǒng ér chí bànjù cái wèn ; túhuà dé gèng qīng le , dàn cháng yào biérén zhēn táiqǐ dōngxī , cái jì qǐ zhǐ shàng de kōng chù bù děngyú jiǎoxià de kōng chù .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said he observed others and asked willingly, yet fear of looking ignorant sometimes delayed a question half a phrase. His drawings were clearer, but often needed someone physically lifting things to remind him that space on paper wasn't space underfoot.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡看完，说他会先看人怎么做，肯问，也会因怕显得不懂而迟半句才问；图画得更清了，但常要别人真抬起东西，才记起纸上的空处不等于脚下的空处。

pairs.target: shuō dào zhèlǐ , tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ chéng lù , jìng méi jí zhe biànjiě , shuō zìjǐ yǐ xiě le dìyīcì cuī rén de nà huí . "
pairs.english: Tavi thought of Cheng Lu and didn't rush to defend himself, saying he had recorded that first impatient time.
pairs.hanzi:
说到这里，塔维想起成路，竟没急着辩解，说自己已写了第一次催人的那回。
“

pairs.target: wǒ kànjiàn le . "
pairs.english: I saw it.”
pairs.hanzi: 我看见了。”

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō , jiāng nà yè liúzài yuánchù , méiyǒu tiān yíjù hǎotīng de zhē guòqù .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said, leaving the page where it was without softening it with praise.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说，将那页留在原处，没有添一句好听的遮过去。

pairs.target: zuìhòu jǐrì gāi jié de gōngqián zhào yuánlái shí zuò yuēdìng jiéqīng , lùfèi shísù lìngjì .
pairs.english: The remaining days' pay was settled under the original placement agreement, travel and lodging separate.
pairs.hanzi: 最后几日该结的工钱照原来实作约定结清，路费食宿另记。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng shù hé guò , méi duōchū yìbǐ jiǎng qián , yě méi shǎo yìbǐ xuétú gāi rěn de kòukuǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi checked the sum: no bonus, no deduction an apprentice must endure.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将数核过，没多出一笔奖钱，也没少一笔学徒该忍的扣款。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiào tā zìjǐ shōu , wèn huíqù hòu shìfǒu xiān zài xuégōng zhù , tǎ wéi shuō xiānjiāo bàogào , xiūxi yíyè , fùhé yǐhòu zài qù kàn sè lā , miǎnde bànlù yòu bào zhe bāo pǎo jǐchù .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng told him to keep it and asked if he'd stay first at the academy. Report first, a night's rest, review then Sela, Tavi said, rather than racing around with his bag.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡叫他自己收，问回去后是否先在学宫住，塔维说先交报告，休息一夜，复核以后再去看瑟拉，免得半路又抱着包跑几处。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn de huòxiāng xiàng shí bèi zǒushí , tǎ wéi zhàojiù zhàn zài huángxiàn hòu , zhídào nà yì shēngxiǎng yuǎn le cái zhuǎnshēn .
pairs.english: When the evening freight carriage left for Shibei, Tavi stayed behind the yellow line as usual until its sound faded.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚的货厢向石背走时，塔维照旧站在黄线后，直到那一声响远了才转身。

pairs.target: chéng lù yǐjīng jiāng bǎn gē huí guì lǐ , táitóu wèn tā míngzǎo hái lái bu lái .
pairs.english: Cheng Lu had returned the board to the cupboard, then asked if he would come tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 成路已经将板搁回柜里，抬头问他明早还来不来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō chē kāi dé zǎo , kǒngpà bù lái , qīngnián biàn yǒudiǎn búzìzài , shuō nà jīnrì suàn shuō guò le , lùshang mànxiē .
pairs.english: The cart left early, probably not, Tavi said. Awkwardly the young man said that counted as goodbye then: travel safely.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说车开得早，恐怕不来，青年便有点不自在，说那今日算说过了，路上慢些。

pairs.target: dù chéng bǎ xiānqián jiè de liǎngzhī wǎn dōu cóng fànpù lǐ qǔchū lái , zài tā miànqián dié le yíxià , shuō zhèhuí qí le , bié bànyè yòu lái zhǎo .
pairs.english: Du Cheng stacked both borrowed bowls from the eatery before him: complete this time, no midnight search.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄把先前借的两只碗都从饭铺里取出来，在他面前叠了一下，说这回齐了，别半夜又来找。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng jiěshì dìèrzhī nàtiān yuán shì fàngzài chuāngtái liàngzhe , dù chéng yǐ bǎ wǎn dìhuí lǎobǎn , xiǎnrán bìng bù dǎsuàn zài tīng yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi started explaining the second had been drying on the windowsill, but Du Cheng returned them to the owner, plainly not planning to hear it again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想解释第二只那天原是放在窗台晾着，杜澄已把碗递回老板，显然并不打算再听一遍。

pairs.target: wēn xiù dào ménbiān shí zhī dài yì jié xuēpíng de fèi mùtiáo .
pairs.english: Wenxiu brought a flattened scrap strip from beside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫到门边时只带一截削平的废木条。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā gē zài zhuōshàng , jiào tā zài shàngtóu huà liáng zhuǎnwān shí sǎo guò de biān , huà wán zìjǐ liú zhe , ruò huíqù fùhé shí yòu zhī huà zuìhòu bǎizài nǎér , zhìshǎo háiyǒu dōngxī néng tíxǐng .
pairs.english: She set it on the table for Tavi to draw the sweep of a beam's turn and keep it after drawing. If he drew only its final place during review again, he would have a reminder.
pairs.hanzi: 她把它搁在桌上，叫他在上头画梁转弯时扫过的边，画完自己留着，若回去复核时又只画最后摆在哪儿，至少还有东西能提醒。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huà dào yíbàn , fāxiàn tā yǐjīng qù tóng jì huái shuō biéde shì , biàn bǎ shèngxià nà dào wān mànmàn huà wán .
pairs.english: Halfway through drawing, Tavi found her already talking to Ji Huai about other things, and slowly finished the rest of the curve.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维画到一半，发现她已经去同纪槐说别的事，便把剩下那道弯慢慢画完。

pairs.target: xià róng cóng zuìhòu yíhù huílái , tiānsè yǐ àn .
pairs.english: By Xiarong's return from her last household it was dark.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒从最后一户回来，天色已暗。

pairs.target: tā méi wèn tā huì buhuì xiǎng zhèlǐ , zhī bǎ xuégōng shōuxìn de zhǐ cóng xiùlǐ lùchū yìjiǎo , shuō bié huànfáng bù shuō .
pairs.english: Rather than asking if he'd miss here, she showed a corner of the academy contact paper: don't move rooms without saying.
pairs.hanzi: 她没问他会不会想这里，只把学宫收信的纸从袖里露出一角，说别换房不说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō huì xiě , yòu bǔ xiàhuí ruò huà yú , gěi tā tiān yìzhāng huì shuōhuà de zuǐ .
pairs.english: He promised to write, adding that next time he would give the fish a talking mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说会写，又补下回若画鱼，给它添一张会说话的嘴。

pairs.target: tā jiào tā xiān bǎ rén huà hǎo , bié měi huí dōu děng bízi .
pairs.english: Draw people properly first, she said: don't always wait for a nose.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫他先把人画好，别每回都等鼻子。

pairs.target: jìnwū hòu , tā jiāng mùtiáo héng fàngzài bāo kǒu , méiyòng tā yā péngyǒu de xìn .
pairs.english: In his room he laid the strip across his bag opening, not pressing it on friends' letters.
pairs.hanzi: 进屋后，他将木条横放在包口，没用它压朋友的信。

pairs.target: chuāngwài chǎng kǒu hái liàng zhe dēng , míngzǎo de kōngxiāng yǐjīng yǒurén bānchūlái .
pairs.english: Yard lamps still shone outside, someone already moving tomorrow's empty crates.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外场口还亮着灯，明早的空箱已经有人搬出来。

pairs.target: tā zuòzài shōu hǎo de chuángbiān tīng le yíhuìer , cái jiāng zìjǐ de dēng chuīxī .
pairs.english: He sat on his packed bed listening a while before blowing out his own lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐在收好的床边听了一会儿，才将自己的灯吹熄。
